question: A solid conducting sphere of radius $R$ carrying a total charge $+Q$ is enclosed by a concentric, uncharged, thin conducting spherical shell of radius $2R$. The entire system is then placed in a uniform external electric field $E₀$. What is the surface charge density $σ$ on the outer surface of the shell at the point where the outward normal vector is parallel to the direction of $E₀$?
